Method of Attack: Ransomware encryptor targeting macOS, specifically Apple Silicon Macs
Encrypts files except for a list of excluded Windows file extensions and folders
Likely test build with incomplete functionality and buffer overflow bug
Based on Linux version compiled for macOS with basic config flags
Requires bypassing TCC and notarization to become functional
Attack Vector: Ransomware encryptor deployed via LockBit ransomware operation
Indicators of Compromise: ZIP archive on VirusTotal containing LockBit encryptors including locker_Apple_M1_64
Presence of Windows and ESXi related strings in macOS encryptor
Exclusion list of Windows file extensions (.exe, .bat, .dll, msstyles, gadget, winmd, ntldr, ntuser.dat.log, bootsect.bak, autorun.inf, thumbs.db, iconcache.db)
